question: Where are a restaurant found within 150 kilometers when heading east from AC Hotel, Atlanta, GA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%AC Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Atlanta%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 150000 -- 150 kilometers in meters ) AND ST_X(p.geometry) > ST_X( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%AC Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Atlanta%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 ) );
